# SimpleDesigns

> Spreadsheets that do the work. Excel and Google Sheets templates that calculate — caseload and therapy trackers, small-business dashboards, budgets, sports pools, life-event planners and hobby logs — plus free browser calculators extracted from them.

Every workbook is a one-time purchase delivered as a file. Every calculator runs entirely client-side, is free, needs no account, and uses the same formulas as the workbook it came from.

## Free tools

- [SLP Progress Statement Builder](https://workingspreadsheets.com/tools/slp-progress-statement-builder/): Turns a baseline, current score, target and condition into a written IEP or therapy progress statement that reports both raw score and progress toward criterion.
- [IEP Goal Progress Calculator](https://workingspreadsheets.com/tools/iep-goal-progress-calculator/): Percent progress toward an IEP goal is (current − baseline) ÷ (target − baseline), clamped to 0–100%. Enter three numbers to get progress, weekly pace and a projected date.
- [SLP Caseload vs Workload Calculator](https://workingspreadsheets.com/tools/slp-caseload-workload-calculator/): SLP workload = (direct + indirect + compliance + other duty minutes) ÷ contracted minutes per week. Shows whether the job fits the paid week and how much direct service is left per student.
- [OT Productivity Calculator](https://workingspreadsheets.com/tools/ot-productivity-calculator/): OT productivity = billable hours ÷ (hours worked − leave hours). The calculator also converts the gap to your target into extra billable minutes per working day.
- [CEU Renewal Calculator](https://workingspreadsheets.com/tools/ceu-renewal-calculator/): CEU renewal calculator: hours remaining = required − earned; pace = remaining ÷ months to renewal. Tracks subject-specific requirements such as ethics hours separately.
